In the text provided, the pronouns are resolved as follows:

*   **"He"** in "He reviewed the patient’s file again..." refers to **Dr. Ellis**.
*   **"he"** in "...to make sure he had all the details in mind" refers to **Dr. Ellis**.
*   **"His"** in "His assistant asked him..." refers to **Dr. Ellis** (indicating the assistant belonging to Dr. Ellis).
*   **"him"** in "...asked him if he was ready..." refers to **Dr. Ellis** (the person being asked).
*   **"he"** in "...if he was ready to begin" refers to **Dr. Ellis** (the person who needs to be ready).

**Answer to the priority question:**
The tool I use to clean my teeth is a **toothbrush**.
